BL-1578 — Three property files under extension/test assert a reach floor over a population they only sample and are flaky red on main with no owner: bl1529ScriptSenderAuditOutcomesInvariant draws outcome kind x stage uniformly for 20 runs and asserts each kind reached 5 (a kind lands under 5 about 1 run in 70), meanTicketTimeCost draws the corpus regime 50/50 for 12 runs and asserts the large regime reached 2 (1 run in 270), and bl622TelegramTokenSeparationInvariant constructs a token collision the subject swarm only sees when exactly two names were drawn (no genuine collision in 30 draws about 1 run in 600); each floor is met by construction on every run and stays asserted at its value
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: every reach floor the three files assert today stays asserted at its value (the floors are load-bearing, BL-1062); the fix is to make each…
BL-1578 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1578" (or "reject BL-1578 <reason>") to act.
